title: The first supervised tick of the autopilot can be limited to named sprints, so its notification half is testable without opening the real backlog
goal: kb-autopilot's tick takes an optional list of sprint ids (argument-hint: [tick] [--only SP[,SP]]); with it, step 5 only starts runners on those sprints and plans no new sprint, review, retro and close run only for them, and the digest says the tick was limited; without it the tick behaves as today. The operator's first supervised tick runs it on the throwaway sprint to see the PushNotification kinds without any real work starting. Planted test: a tick limited to one sprint starts no runner on another started sprint. Found by the first supervised run (Stage 7 notification half had no safe way to run).
